newsitem.title: USA: Pacific Sunwear Aug sales rose 19 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Sunwear Aug sales rose 19 pct.

text.p: Pacific Sunwear of California Inc said on Thursday same-store sales for the four-week period ended Sept 1 rose 19 percent.
Total sales for the period were up 40 percent to $20 million from $14.3 million. The four-week period last year ended on Sept. 3.
The mall-based specialty retailer of everyday casual apparel aimed at the teenage customer reported strong fashion trends in jeanswear, junior merchandise and footwear.
The company currently operates 198 stores in 33 states and said it was pleased with sales of the sixteen new stores opened in 1996.
Same store sales for the 30 weeks ended Sept 1 rose 11 percent over last year and total sales were up 41 percent.
